name: 古堡疑云
author: 卡慕萝米

name: Knight
ability: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.

name: Noble
ability: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.

name: Investigator
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.

name: Bounty Hunter
ability: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]

name: Balloonist
ability: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]

name: Dreamer
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.

name: Alchemist
ability: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.

name: Cannibal
ability: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.

name: Amnesiac
ability: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.

name: Farmer
ability: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.

name: Magician
ability: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.

name: Atheist
ability: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]

name: Poppy Grower
ability: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.

name: Drunk
ability: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.

name: Plague Doctor
ability: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.

name: Mutant
ability: If you are "mad" about being an Outsider, you might be executed.

name: Heretic
ability: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.

name: Marionette
ability: You think you are a good character, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]

name: Summoner
ability: You get 3 bluffs. On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]

name: Organ Grinder
ability: All players keep their eyes closed when voting and the vote tally is secret. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.

name: Baron
ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

name: Lil' Monsta
ability: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]

name: Ojo
ability: Each night*, choose a character: they die. If they are not in play, the Storyteller chooses who dies.

name: Kazali
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions. -? to +? Outsiders]

name: Lord of Typhon
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [Evil characters are in a line. You are in the middle. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]

name: Spirit of Ivory
ability: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.

name: Bounty Hunter & Kazali
ability: If the Kazali turns the Bounty Hunter into a Minion, an evil Townsfolk is not created.

name: Alchemist & Marionette
ability: An Alchemist-Marionette has no Marionette ability & the Marionette is in play.

name: Alchemist & Organ Grinder
ability: If the Alchemist has the Organ Grinder ability, the Organ Grinder is in play. If both are sober, both are drunk.

name: Alchemist & Summoner
ability: The Alchemist-Summoner does not get bluffs, and chooses which Demon but not which player. If they die before this happens, evil wins. [No Demon]

name: Cannibal & Poppy Grower
ability: If the Cannibal eats the Poppy Grower, then dies or loses the Poppy Grower ability, the Demon and Minions learn each other that night.

name: Magician & Marionette
ability: If the Magician is alive, the Demon doesn't know which neighbor is the Marionette.

name: Plague Doctor & Baron
ability: If the Storyteller would gain the Baron ability, up to two players become Outsiders.

name: Plague Doctor & Marionette
ability: If the Storyteller would gain the Marionette ability, one of the Demon's good neighbors becomes the Marionette.

name: Heretic & Baron
ability: The Baron might only add 1 Outsider, not 2.

name: Marionette & Balloonist
ability: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Balloonist, an Outsider might have been added during setup.

name: Marionette & Kazali
ability: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.

name: Marionette & Lil' Monsta
ability: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.

name: Marionette & Summoner
ability: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.

name: Summoner & Kazali
ability: If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

name: Summoner & Lord of Typhon
ability: If a Lord of Typhon is summoned, they must neighbor a Minion & their other neighbor becomes an evil Minion.

name: Summoner & Poppy Grower
ability: If the Poppy Grower is alive on the 3rd night, the Summoner chooses which Demon but not which player.

name: Lil' Monsta & Magician
ability: If the Magician is alive, the Storyteller chooses which Minion babysits Lil' Monsta.

name: Lil' Monsta & Poppy Grower
ability: If Lil' Monsta & the Poppy Grower are alive, Minions wake one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
